_comment: WO-5 step two, ADR 0020 cell C (depth: A with 4 blocks), on cuda. Fixed settings (ADR 0020): feed-forward 4x hidden,
dropout 0.2, Adam 1e-3, 512 examples per step, seed 42, exact search, the objective of record
(strict-prefix-final-position-v1). Early stopping as WO-4 built it: a seeded 1% of training users give up
their last training example as the probe, recall@500 after each pass, stop when it improves by less than
0.5% relative, at least 3 and at most 5 passes (epochs is the ceiling).
Sweep order 5 of 6 (cheapest projected first: 0b, A, E, B, C, D). Killed past 2x its projected time.
Full data (sample_fraction 1.0) under the full protocol: ADR 0011's cold-start cohort attached, so the
protocol hash is v1's of record, sha256:b4ed5afa... (run 528b1451). Logged to the pod's own SQLite MLflow
store, bundled after the run, re-scored on the Mac CPU from its saved weights (ADR 0020 D6; owner condition 5).
Run only by infra/gpu/sweep.sh under the step-two approval (decision register D-052).

projection.hours_per_pass_basis: PROJECTED, not measured: cell A's measured 0.625 h/pass x ADR 0020's cost ratio against A (2.000)
